articles.title: Robinhood sees surge in bitcoin, gold prediction markets as traders move beyond sports
articles.snippet: The company's head of futures and prediction markets said bitcoin, gold and oil contracts are among its fastest-growing prediction markets.

articles.title: Bitcoin Core changes security rules as AI makes finding code bugs dangerously easy
articles.snippet: Developers merged a policy change that ends the months-long embargo for flaws a chatbot could rediscover, after a summer in which AI found hundreds of bitcoin bugs before the humans did.

articles.title: Live updates: Bitcoin holds above $81,000 as oil prices hit six-month high
articles.snippet: Brent crude oil surged above $116 per barrel for the first time since late April.

articles.title: Bitcoin appears to have decoupled from midterm cycle bottom history
articles.snippet: Previous bitcoin bear-market lows followed U.S. midterms, but this year’s recovery raises the possibility that the bottom arrived months earlier.

articles.title: Sweden’s central bank revives e-krona debate as stablecoins and digital euro loom
articles.snippet: The Riksbank sees an e-krona as critical to securing national payments and monetary control.
